task: Day 2 (Tuesday) — Messaging: ActiveMQ + RabbitMQ (T2.1–T2.9): embedded ActiveMQ broker for booking notifications + RabbitMQ fanout for tour promotions + notifications DB table + integration into BookingServiceImpl and TourServiceImpl
acceptanceCriteria: T2.1: App boots with embedded ActiveMQ broker; JmsTemplate + Queue beans available (spring.activemq.broker-url=vm://localhost?broker.persistent=false)
T2.2: Flyway V7 migration creates notifications table with user_id FK, type, title, message, is_read columns; Notification entity + NotificationRepository + NotificationDto wired
T2.3: BookingNotificationProducer.sendNotification() sends object message to booking.notifications queue via JmsTemplate
T2.4: BookingNotificationConsumer @JmsListener receives message and persists via NotificationService.saveNotification()
T2.5: adminConfirmBooking sends BOOKING_CONFIRMED; adminCancelBooking sends BOOKING_CANCELLED — each inserts exactly one notifications row for the booking's user
T2.6: RabbitMQ fanout exchange tour.promotions + tour.promo.notification.queue + tour.promo.log.queue declared; app boots connected to RabbitMQ broker
T2.7: TourPromotionPublisher.publishNewTour() sends TourPromotionMessage as JSON to tour.promotions fanout exchange
T2.8: TourPromotionNotificationListener calls broadcastTourPromotion() inserting N notifications rows (one per active user); TourPromotionLogListener logs INFO
T2.9: TourServiceImpl.create()/update() publish tour-promotion message when saved tour status is ACTIVE
blastRadius: BookingServiceImpl: adminConfirmBooking + adminCancelBooking — additive messaging side-effects only, no logic changes
TourServiceImpl: create + update — additive publish call after save, no validation changes
UserRepository: new findAllActiveUserIds() query — additive only
Test context: application-test.properties gains broker stubs + listener auto-startup=false
contracts: AMQP: TourPromotionMessage (JSON) → tour.promotions fanout exchange → 2 queues
NotificationService: saveNotification, getUnreadCount, getNotifications, markAllRead, broadcastTourPromotion
